annotations.title: Look up a permit by number

description: Look up a permit by the permit number assigned by the issuing jurisdiction, optionally narrowed by city and state. The number is matched exactly (ignoring case), and the same number can exist in several jurisdictions, so up to 5 matching permits are returned; give the city or state to tell them apart. If nothing matches exactly and a city or state was given, permits in that place whose number contains the text are returned instead, and `match` says "partial". When the connected account covers a limited date range, `account_window_from` is set and only permits from that date onward are searched. Results carry no property owner name, owner mailing address or permit applicant name fields.

city.description: City where the permit was issued (optional, narrows the match)

permit_number.description: The permit number from the issuing jurisdiction

state.description: Two-letter state code (optional, narrows the match)

name: get_permit
title: Look up a permit by number
